# Story tools

## Macros (one macro beat replaces many beats; prefer them)

A beat macro is `{ "id", "at", "macro", "params" }`; a scene macro (fight_card, montage) is a scene entry `{ "id", "macro", "params" }`. Reference a macro like a beat (`{"after": "fight1"}`) or by its anchors (`{"on": "fight1.finisher"}`).

| macro | params (bold = required) | anchors | defaults | what you get |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| @dialogue | **lines**: [lines <=30]; gap: num 0-3; gestures: bool; camera: auto/none | start, end, line<N> | gap=0.3 gestures=true camera=auto | Characters talk in turn with talk gestures, reading-time pacing, faces and a two-shot. lines: [[who, text<=120, face?, bubble?], ...] |
| @activity | **name**: blow_bubbles/tennis_rally/play_catch/kick_ball/eat_together/dance_together/selfie/sleep/comfort/fetch; **with**: [ids <=4]; reps: int 1-40; dur: num 1-120; intensity: low/medium/high; ending: win/miss/laugh/interrupted; winner: id; object: id | start, end, ending | intensity=medium | A little game kept in sync (see Activities): the players walk to their places, play, and finish with the ending. |
| @walk_together | **who**: [ids <=4]; **to**: {"x"} or {"near","gap"} or {"exit"}; pace: walk/run; holdHands: bool | start, end | pace=walk holdHands=true | Hand in hand (two walkers) or side by side to `to`. |
| @travel | **who**: [ids <=4]; **to**: {"x"} or {"near","gap"} or {"exit"}; mode: walk/run/sneak; camera: track/wide/none | start, end | mode=walk camera=track | A long walk/run/sneak to `to` with the camera tracking the first walker. |
| @enter | **who**: id; **side**: left/right; mode: walk/run/sneak; to: {"x"} or {"near","gap"} or {"exit"} | start, end | mode=walk | Walks (or runs) in from `side` to `to` (default: its scene x). Place the character in the scene cast with "hidden": true. |
| @exit | **who**: id; **side**: left/right; mode: walk/run/sneak | start, end | mode=walk | Walks (or runs) off toward `side` and fades out. |
| @fight | **sides**: [ids <=2]; **winner**: id; exchanges: int 1-30; intensity: low/medium/high; style: even/dominant/comeback/close; finisher: string; ko: bool; phases: [objects <=4] | start, end, finisher, ko | exchanges=6 / 8 / 10 by intensity intensity=medium style=even ko=true | A whole 1v1: opening taunts, exchanges weighted to the winner, a slowmo finisher, the KO (ko: false leaves the loser standing and dizzy, e.g. before @defeat captured). |
| @gauntlet | **hero**: id; **opponents**: [ids <=6]; per: int 1-10; travel: walk/run/none; intensity: low/medium/high; finisher: string; afterDefeat: stay/fade | start, end, opponent<N>, finisher | per=3 travel=run intensity=medium afterDefeat=stay | The hero takes on each opponent in turn (travel run/walk between them, or none: they wait in a ring). Place opponents along the stage in order. |
| @brawl | **teams**: {a, b}; **winner**: a/b; dur: num 5-120; intensity: low/medium/high | start, end | dur=20 intensity=medium | Two teams; at most two clashes at once; the losing team goes down one by one. |
| @chase | **runner**: id; **chasers**: [ids <=4]; dur: num 3-60; obstacles: int 0-6; caught: bool | start, end, caught | dur=8 obstacles=0 caught=false | The runner flees, everyone jumps the obstacles, the lead chaser lunges; caught or gets away. |
| @defeat | **who**: id; by: id; **style**: ko/faint/vanish/ghost/captured/flee/petrify | start, end, gone | - | A stagger and close-up, then the defeat style; `by` reacts. The victim must be standing (not KO'd). |
| @grief | **who**: id; over: id; dur: num 2-20; rain: bool | start, end | dur=6 rain=false | Kneels by `over`, cries for `dur` seconds, sad music, optional rain. |
| @fight_card | title: string; **matchups**: [objects <=6]; intro: bool; breathers: bool; finale: boss/plain; minDur: num 60-900 | - | intro=true breathers=true finale=boss minDur=180 | SCENE macro: a fight-only video (title, intro, rounds, breathers, finale, end card) from matchups. Written as a scene entry {id, macro, params}. |
| @montage | **clips**: [objects <=8]; clipDur: num 1-10; cut: cut/dissolve/wipe | - | clipDur=3 cut=cut | SCENE macro: 2-8 short clips with quick cuts and one music bed. Written as a scene entry {id, macro, params}. |

One example of each macro is in 08_examples.md.

## Activities (`@activity` name; `object`: a set piece it can use)

| activity | players | objects | ends with | about |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| blow_bubbles | 1-4 | - | laugh | One blows bubbles with a wand while friends poke and pop them; ends laughing. |
| tennis_rally | 2 | tennis_net | miss | Two players hit a tennis ball over the net until one misses. |
| play_catch | 2 | - | laugh | Two friends toss and catch a ball; ends laughing. |
| kick_ball | 2 | - | win | Two friends kick a football back and forth. |
| eat_together | 1-4 | bench, chair | laugh | Friends sit (on a bench or chairs) and eat together. |
| dance_together | 1-4 | - | laugh | Everyone dances together. |
| selfie | 1-4 | - | laugh | One takes a selfie with the phone while the others cheer. |
| sleep | 1-4 | bench | none | Characters lie down (on a bench if given) and sleep. |
| comfort | 2 | - | hug | One comforts a crying friend, ending in a hug. |
| fetch | 2 | - | laugh | A friend throws a ball and a dog fetches it back in its mouth; ends laughing. |

## Defeat styles (`@defeat` style, or as moves)
kids: ko, faint, vanish, captured, flee, petrify; general: ko, faint, vanish, ghost, captured, flee, petrify. See the defeat moves in 03_moves.md.

## Music moods (scene `music`: `{ "mood", "intensity": 0-1 }`)

| mood | feel |
|---|---|
| happy | Bright and cheerful major-key tune; a sunny day. |
| playful | Bouncy toy-like tune for games and silly moments. |
| calm | Slow, dreamy flute and bells; quiet moments. |
| sad | Slow minor flute; loss and missing someone. |
| tense | Uneasy pulse; something is wrong. |
| mysterious | Glassy, eerie and slow; caves, secrets, the unknown. |
| heroic | Brassy and brave; setting off on a quest. |
| battle | Fast and driving; a fight. |
| boss | Fast, dark and heavy; the final fight against the villain. |
| triumphant | Big brassy victory; the happy ending. |
| lullaby | Slow music box; bedtime and sleep. |

## Camera (scene `camera` keys, or `shot` world beats)

| mode | needs | what it frames |
|---|---|---|
| follow | - | Keeps the `targets` (default: everyone) in frame; the fight camera. |
| focus | target | Centers on one `target`, e.g. on the biggest hit. |
| fixed | x | Holds still on stage position `x`. |
| pan | x | Pans to stage position `x` over `dur` seconds. |
| push | - | Slowly pushes in (zooms) over `dur` seconds. |
| two_shot | targets | Frames two characters tightly (talking). |
| close_up | target | Head and shoulders of `target` (strong feelings). |
| wide | - | The whole stage (openings, crowds). |
| over_shoulder | target, from | Past `from`, looking at `target`. |
| track | target | Follows `target` with lead room ahead (travel, chases). |

Story scenes without camera keys get the story camera: a wide at the start, two-shots while someone talks, close-ups on cry, furious or determined faces, and the fight camera in fights. A shot beat or a camera key always wins.

## Transitions and cards (scene `transitionIn` / `transitionOut`)

| type | what it does |
|---|---|
| cut | Instant change to the next scene. |
| fade | Fades through black between scenes. |
| dissolve | Cross-fades from one scene into the next. |
| wipe | A directional wipe (`dir` left, right, up or down). |
| iris | A circle closes on `target` and opens on them in the next scene. |
| card | A full-screen card between scenes (`kind` title, chapter, time or end). |

| card kind | use |
|---|---|
| title | The story title (`title`, optional `subtitle`); usually the first scene's transitionIn. |
| chapter | A chapter heading (`text`). |
| time | A time skip (`text`). |
| end | The end card (`text`); usually the last scene's transitionOut. |

At a scene boundary the next scene's transitionIn wins, then the previous scene's transitionOut, else cut. Transitions add video time but no story time.

| do | params (* required) | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| music_cue | cue*:start/stop/duck volume:0-1 | Starts, stops or ducks the music. |
| narrate | text*:text<=160 pos:top/bottom dur:0.5-15 style:box/plain | Narration text in a box at the top or bottom (stories). |
| title_card | title*:text<=60 subtitle:text<=80 dur:0.5-10 bg:#rrggbb | A full-screen title card with an optional subtitle. |
| chapter_card | text*:text<=80 dur:0.5-10 bg:#rrggbb | A full-screen chapter card. |
| time_card | text*:text<=80 dur:0.5-10 bg:#rrggbb | A full-screen time-skip card. |
| end_card | text*:text<=80 dur:0.5-10 bg:#rrggbb | A full-screen end card. |
| set_appearance | who*:id accessory:headband/scarf/cape/hat/antenna/bowtie/mask/crown/backpack/eyepatch/hair_flower/sprout/mittens/horns/turban/moustache/stub_horns/bracelet/chilli_hat/pirate_hat/beard color:#rrggbb remove:true/false eyes:dot/big/oval/sleepy/visor/glasses brows:none/thin/thick mouthStyle:line/cartoon hair:none/spiky/bob/ponytail/cap/bun hairColor:#rrggbb outfit:none/shirt/coat/armor/robe outfitColor:#rrggbb cheeks:#rrggbb belly:#rrggbb slots:0-7 | Changes how a character looks mid-story: add or remove an accessory, change hair, outfit or eyes. |
| set_glow | who*:id color level*:0-1 dur:0-10 | A lasting glow around a character: a color or "rainbow", level 0-1 (0: off), over dur; carries over scenes. |
| set_grade | saturation*:0-1 dur:0-10 keepCast:true/false from:id | Scene colour: saturation 1 full, 0 grey, over dur; keepCast keeps the cast in colour; from: a wave out from a character. |
| shot | mode*:follow/focus/fixed/pan/push/two_shot/close_up/wide/over_shoulder/track target:id targets:[ids <=4] from:id zoom:0.3-4 dur:0.2-30 | A camera shot from a beat (wide, close_up, two_shot, ...); with dur the previous framing comes back. |
| set_music | mood:happy/playful/calm/sad/tense/mysterious/heroic/battle/boss/triumphant/lullaby intensity:0-1 volume:0-1 fade:0-10 | Changes the music mood, intensity or volume inside a scene. |
| activity | name*:blow_bubbles/tennis_rally/play_catch/kick_ball/eat_together/dance_together/selfie/sleep/comfort/fetch with*:[ids <=4] reps:1-40 dur:1-120 intensity:low/medium/high ending:win/miss/laugh/interrupted winner:id object | Runs an activity directly (the runtime form of @activity; prefer the macro). |

## Audience rules

Audience: KIDS (the default). Family friendly and gore free:
- Defeat styles: ko, faint, vanish, captured, flee, petrify (never ghost). The villain ends knocked out, captured or fleeing; never an execution.
- A loved character's loss is temporary or hopeful: if someone vanishes, a later scene brings them back with "return".
- Revenge becomes rescue or justice in the narration ("Kai set out to save Pip").
- Swords, bats and staffs are fine in fights; nobody aims a weapon at someone who cannot fight back (a villain's energy blast at a defenseless friend is allowed as the story's incident).
- Short sentences, simple words, and a clear lesson at the end (friendship, courage, kindness).
- Avoid these words (say the alternative): "kill" → "defeat", "killed" → "defeated", "murder" → "defeat", "die" → "be gone", "died" → "was lost", "dead" → "gone", "death" → "loss", "hate" → "really don't like", "stupid" → "silly", "idiot" → "silly goose", "shut up" → "be quiet", "gun" → "blaster", "knife" → "a toy".

Audience: general. All defeat styles are allowed, including ghost. Losses may be permanent. Avoid these words (say the alternative): "kill" → "defeat", "killed" → "defeated", "murder" → "defeat".
